acceptanceCriteria: Summaries are derived only from repository content at the indexed revision, never generated, and are byte-reproducible.
Rows from the summary unit name the source comment range.
Measured on the frozen retrieval evaluation.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: there is no per-file summary unit; documentation rows point at whole files. Derive a one-line role summary per file from package and top-level doc comments deterministically and index it as a retrieval unit with its own reason. Prior art: arXiv 2607.11046. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md.
title: context: role-line file summaries from doc comments as a retrieval unit
